bindingRules: Copying this descriptive nested template does not supply root authority; root must separately approve, commit and pin exact grant bytes
Both refs require 40 lowercase hex commit, repository-relative non-instruction path, and 64 lowercase hex sha256; committed JSON limit65536 bytes
Preserve command key order and nodeArgs order: V4 compares JSON.stringify exactly
planSha256 hashes JSON.stringify({limits:plan.limits,command:plan.command,phase:'admission',operations:plan.admission}); not raw OPERATION-PLAN.json bytes
Changing runId requires matching grant outputRoot/command and CLI runId; current example proposes only admission-v4-01
No independent top-level budgets, maxChildren, semanticCalls, stagedSha256 or permissions field is consumed from a V4 root grant
Do not supply acceptedAdmission for this admission phase; only the separately authorized cohort uses acceptedAdmission:{path,sha256}
Cohort reads actual accepted admission RESULT and checks its stagedSha256 against adjacent STAGED.json; no automatic cohort execution

additionalActualAdmissionResultFields.children: 14 enrolled launch entries, operation identity, config hash, PID/group, exit/close/reap, persistence hash and errors
additionalActualAdmissionResultFields.rows: coordinator initializes empty array; not the control rows
additionalActualAdmissionResultFields.probes: serial result with three safely qualified probe rows
additionalActualAdmissionResultFields.controls: serial result with twelve qualified control-family rows
additionalActualAdmissionResultFields.plannedOperations: fourteen {id,launch} rows; launch is actual ledger ordinal or null when unrun
additionalActualAdmissionResultFields.evidenceBytesBeforeFinal: persisted evidence accounting before final write

failureFieldsAndDisposition.fatal: present when outer execution catches an error
failureFieldsAndDisposition.finalPersistenceError: retained in memory and stderr emergency envelope if final RESULT persistence fails
